Chief Complaint
Follow-up for Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia.

HPI
Pt is a 56 y.o. female presenting for f/u of Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia. Pt has been on long-term high-dose steroids for chronic lung condition. Currently undergoing treatment with trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole. Pt reports mild persistent cough but denies fever, chills, or increased SOB. Tolerating meds well.

Medication List
- Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole
- Prednisone (high-dose)

Exam
Gen: Well-appearing, in no acute distress.
Resp: CTAB, RRR. Breath sounds clear bilaterally.
CV: RRR, no murmurs.
Ext: WNL.

Assessment
1. Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia: Pt is currently on trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole and continuing high-dose steroids for underlying lung pathology. Progressing well on current regimen.

Plan
- Continue trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole as prescribed.
- Continue high-dose steroids.
- F/u in 2 weeks to monitor progress and pulmonary status.

Electronically signed, D. Kowalski, MD, 05/14/2026
